note: Personas and journey maps for the archive. Shown on site/making.html and used as the reference for design decisions. These are working assumptions drawn from docs/BRIEF.md and docs/BIBLE.md, not findings from interviews. The people are invented. Replace them with what real readers say once the site has been tested with five people (docs/PLAN.md).

personas.label: The reader on a phone
personas.name: Rumana Khatun
personas.quote: I will give it one screen. If it is not clear by then, I go back to WhatsApp.
personas.arrives: From a WhatsApp forward about Ila Mitra on the anniversary of the Nachole uprising.
personas.device: A low-cost Android phone on mobile data. Reads Bangla first, English slowly.
personas.wants: To know what happened near her town, in about two minutes, and whether it can be trusted enough to forward.
personas.leaves_when: The first screen is a map, a code or a wall of English.

personas.label: The organiser
personas.name: Dipankar Roy
personas.who: 29, organiser with an agricultural workers' union, Purba Bardhaman
personas.quote: I need to show the line from then to now, and send a link that opens on exactly the right thing.
personas.arrives: On purpose, to prepare a study circle on sharecroppers' rights.
personas.device: His phone, and a shared laptop at the union office. Reads Bangla and English.
personas.wants: The sequence of a movement in order, the line from Tebhaga to today's land struggles, and links he can drop into a group chat.
personas.leaves_when: The story stops in 1950 with nothing connecting it to the present.

personas.label: The student or researcher
personas.name: Ananya Ghosh
personas.quote: Show me where each claim comes from. If the source is a study-notes site, I am gone.
personas.arrives: From a search engine, looking for sources on women in the Tebhaga movement.
personas.device: A laptop, with a dozen tabs open.
personas.wants: Citations with page numbers, primary and secondary sources told apart, and the points on which accounts disagree.
personas.leaves_when: Sources are missing, vague or Wikipedia.

personas.label: The descendant
personas.name: Bimal Barman
personas.who: 58, grandson of a Dinajpur sharecropper, Dakshin Dinajpur
personas.quote: My grandfather was there. His name is spelled wrong, and our village is not mentioned.
personas.arrives: His son opens an entry on his phone and hands it to him.
personas.device: His son's phone. Reads Bangla. Does not type in English and has never heard of GitHub.
personas.wants: To find his family's village and people, and to tell the archive when something about them is wrong.
personas.leaves_when: There is no way to say so.

journeys.goal: Understand one entry within 30 seconds of landing on it (the brief's first test of success).

steps.does: Taps a link to the Ila Mitra entry in a WhatsApp group.
steps.before: The link preview in WhatsApp was blank, because the page was filled in by a script after loading.
steps.open: Still blank. Fixing it needs real pages generated for each entry (plan D9).

steps.does: Looks for what this is, in her language.
steps.before: The first things on the page were a code, pe_ila_mitra, and the word "person". English only.
steps.now: The name, her role and a one-paragraph summary come first. The code is gone from the page.
steps.open: No Bangla yet. None of the 82 entries has Bangla text.

steps.does: Reads the summary, perhaps the entry.
steps.before: The editor's note was in red and read like an error message.
steps.now: A line under the summary says how well the entry is sourced. Open questions sit in a calm box titled "What we have not verified yet".

steps.does: Taps one link to learn more.
steps.before: Links were labelled with internal terms such as "named_in".
steps.now: Connected entries are grouped as people, events, places and so on, in plain words. A movement lists what happened in order.

steps.does: Forwards it to a cousin.
steps.before: She had to copy the address from the browser bar.
steps.now: A "Share this entry" button opens the phone's share sheet.
steps.open: The forwarded link still shows no preview.

journeys.goal: Prepare a study circle and share exact links.

steps.does: Opens the home page on the union's laptop.
steps.before: A map with unlabelled dots and three filters. Nothing said what the site was.
steps.now: One sentence says what the archive is. Below it are a search box and the two movements to start with.

steps.does: Wants Tebhaga from beginning to end.
steps.before: A timeline of dots at start dates. People and organisations could not be reached from the home page at all.
steps.now: The movement's page lists its events in date order. Each event links to the one before and the one after.
steps.open: On the timeline, movements are still dots, not bars showing how long they lasted (Bible G4).

steps.does: Reads the events one by one.
steps.before: Each event opened in a small card on top of the map.
steps.now: Each event is a full page that reads comfortably on a phone.

steps.does: Looks for the line from Tebhaga to today.
steps.before: Nothing after 1950.
steps.open: Still nothing. The "Since then" sections (Bible H2) have to be written. Design cannot supply them.

steps.does: Pastes links into the group chat.
steps.before: Filters and views were not in the address, so a link always opened the default map.
steps.now: A search, a chosen kind of entry, the timeline view and an entry opened on the map are all in the address.
steps.open: The map's year and region filters are not in the address yet.

journeys.goal: Decide whether the archive can be cited, and find its sources.

steps.does: Searches the web for sources on women in Tebhaga.
steps.before: Search engines saw empty pages, so entries could not be found this way.

steps.does: Checks whether the site is serious about evidence.
steps.before: A red tag reading "contested / verify sources" covered two different things: disagreement and thin sourcing.
steps.now: Every entry states its sourcing in one line: sourced, thinly sourced or not yet verified. The status page shows the totals.
steps.open: 35 of 82 entries are not yet verified. The line makes that visible. Only editing fixes it.

steps.does: Reads the claims.
steps.before: Running text with no indication of which source supports which statement.
steps.open: Unchanged. Needs sources as their own records with page numbers (plan D7) and disputed points stored as claims (Bible E2).

steps.does: Opens the source list.
steps.before: Fifty source links led nowhere, and study-notes sites were listed like any other source.
steps.now: Sources without a web address are shown as plain citations. Banned sources are labelled "research lead only, to be replaced".
steps.open: No page numbers. No record of whose voice a source is: state, party, participant, press or scholar (Bible E1).

steps.does: Cites the entry in a seminar paper.
steps.before: No stable way to cite, no licence.
steps.now: The share button copies the entry's address.
steps.open: No "cite this entry" line with a date, and no licence yet (Bible C4).

journeys.goal: Find his family's place in the record and correct it.

steps.does: Is handed a phone showing the Dinajpur entry.
steps.before: Places had bare pages, and no page listed what happened there.
steps.now: A place page shows what the place was called before and after 1947, and every entry connected to it.

steps.does: Looks for his grandfather's name and village.
steps.before: There was no search. People could only be reached two taps deep.
steps.now: The home page searches every name. People and places each have a list.
steps.open: Search works in English spelling only.

steps.does: Reads what the archive says about the movement in his district.
steps.before: Leaders were named. Ordinary participants mostly were not.
steps.open: Unchanged. Naming ordinary participants and communities is editorial work (Bible P1, P2).

steps.does: Sees a spelling he knows is wrong.
steps.before: Nothing admitted that entries might be incomplete.
steps.now: The entry says plainly what has not been verified yet.

steps.does: Wants to tell the archive.
steps.before: No route at all.
steps.open: Still none. A correction form that needs no account (Bible C2, P5) comes once the site is on Netlify.
